name: Crimson Down The Creek
source:
Follow Stevantio, a university student haunted by the ghost of a student who was murdered in the creek. Uncover your truth and bring her peace, but be wary of where you step or perhaps become the next story whispered by the people.

[From [url=https://vnjcafeumn.itch.io/crimson-down-the-creek]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随Stevantio，一名大学生，他被一名在小溪中被谋杀的学生的鬼魂所困扰。揭露你的真相并给她带来平安，但要小心你的脚步，否则可能会成为人们低声议论的下一个故事。

[来自[url=https://vnjcafeumn.itch.io/crimson-down-the-creek]itch.io[/url]]
